A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work with the same title, authors and research framework. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations and appendices A–E are readable and can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original QA experiments in Tables 1–2, NLI evaluation results in Figures 2–6, and generated-answer case studies in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains these original QA experiments, NLI evaluations and qualitative case studies, including the results in the appendices.

M1.justification: The diversity penalty, NLI adaptation, importance weighting, control variates and adaptive sampling procedures are unchanged. Writing q with a tilde in Equations 5 and 7 clarifies unnormalized scores; Algorithms 1–2 already applied softmax in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions use CoQA, TriviaQA, AmbigQA and TruthfulQA, alongside MNLI training and evaluation with prefix truncation or masking. The represented tasks and qualitative test scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same comparators: vanilla sampling, temperature-2 sampling, DBS and SDLG, with the same exclusions for masked diffusion models. The revised SDLG bibliography entry does not change its described implementation or comparison membership.

E3.justification: Section 5 and the appendices retain the same models, data splits, preprocessing and evaluation procedures. SE still uses 16 generations and a ROUGE-L threshold of 0.3; MI uses eight answer pairs and a threshold of 0.2.

E4.justification: The NLI truncation and masking analyses, adaptive-diversity trajectory in Figure 7, and Hubble-constant case studies in Appendix C are retained. No ablation, robustness test or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both AUROC tables report mean and standard deviation over five jackknife samples of size 200. Figure 6 retains averaging over 20 masking realizations. No run-count, seed or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The numerical entries in Tables 1–2, plotted results and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, the proposed method's CoQA SE AUROC with OPT-6.7B remains 0.75±0.02, and its CoQA MI AUROC with LLaMA 3 8B-Instruct remains 0.68±0.07.

T1.justification: The uncertainty definitions, importance-weighted estimators, assumptions and Appendix E derivation are unchanged. Equations 5 and 7 receive notation clarifying their unnormalized status, already reflected in v1's description and sampling algorithms, without revised mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and scope: gradient-free semantic steering for autoregressive and masked diffusion models, importance correction, control variates and improved sample efficiency across four QA benchmarks.

C2.justification: Sections 6–7 and Appendix D retain the same interpretations and limitations concerning semantic coverage, sequential computation, NLI noise, prompt dependence and modest, high-variance MI results. The related-work revisions do not alter these interpretations.

D1.justification: Appendix B retains the same checkpoint, augmentation procedures, optimizer settings, prompts, clustering instructions, complexity discussion and code-access information. The NVIDIA A100 hardware and memory requirement below 32 GB are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The supporting literature is substantially revised across several areas. v2 replaces the earlier conformal references with Conformal Nucleus Sampling and Conformal Risk Control, adds Uncertainty Distillation and PPDB 2.0, and replaces multiple paraphrase references with BERT, Phrase-BERT and bilingual-corpus work. Section 4 also revises the conformal-guarantee description and adds bilingual-corpus paraphrasing, beyond citation renumbering and metadata corrections.

P1.justification: Changes include localized rewriting in Section 4, explicit unnormalized-distribution wording, punctuation and algorithm-comment edits, and bibliographic corrections. The main narrative, section order and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Revised reference entries reflow the bibliography across pages 11–15, with small text-spacing shifts elsewhere. All seven figures and both tables retain their designs, content and placement; table citation numbers are updated.

improvement.justification: v2 replaces explicit reference placeholders such as arXiv identifiers ending in XXXX with specified sources, revises related-work attribution, and clarifies unnormalized proposal notation. These changes improve traceability and clarity. The demonstrated benefit is concentrated in scholarly documentation and exposition; the scientific procedures, evidence and derivations remain unchanged.
